metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for everyday development work by Stefan Petrovici

plugins.name: a11y-enforcer
plugins.description: Find WCAG 2.2 accessibility problems in HTML, React, Vue, Svelte and Astro: missing alt text and labels, keyboard traps, focus issues and color contrast, then fix them.

plugins.name: api-doc-generator
plugins.description: Write OpenAPI 3.1 docs from the real routes in Express, NestJS, Next.js, FastAPI, Flask, Spring and Go code, and check in CI that the docs still match the code.

plugins.name: api-drift-detector
plugins.description: Catch breaking API changes before production: compare TypeScript types across frontend, backend and Prisma or SQL schemas, and confirm mismatches with tsc.

plugins.name: aws-cost-guard
plugins.description: Find out why your AWS bill grew: costs by service, idle EC2, EBS and Elastic IPs, plus failing Kubernetes pods explained from logs. Read-only, uses your aws and kubectl CLI.

plugins.name: bundle-size-sentinel
plugins.description: Keep JavaScript bundles small: check npm dependencies before adding them, and measure raw and gzip size of every JS and CSS file in your build, with before and after comparison.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Make Claude answer short and to the point: answer or code first, no filler, no repeated questions. A concise mode that saves reading time and output tokens.

plugins.name: ci-optimizer
plugins.description: Speed up and secure GitHub Actions and GitLab CI: find missing caches, wasted runs, missing timeouts, unpinned actions and flaky tests, using your real run times.

plugins.name: code-metrics-tracker
plugins.description: Measure cyclomatic complexity, long functions, large files and duplicated code in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go and more, and track tech debt over time.

plugins.name: context-compactor
plugins.description: Keep long Claude Code sessions fast and under the context limit: read less, summarize state, and get the exact /compact command that keeps what matters.

plugins.name: db-migration-safety
plugins.description: Check SQL migrations for table locks, data loss and changes that break the running app, get the safer way to write each one, and a rollback plan before you deploy.

plugins.name: db-schema-spy
plugins.description: See your real database schema before writing SQL: tables, columns, foreign keys and indexes from Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails or migrations, with Mermaid ER diagrams.

plugins.name: dependency-sentinel
plugins.description: Check npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, RubyGems and Composer lockfiles for known CVEs with OSV.dev, get the fixed versions, and flag GPL, AGPL and non-commercial licenses.

plugins.name: dockerfile-optimizer
plugins.description: Review Dockerfiles for image size, build cache order and security: multi-stage builds, slim base images, non-root users, no secrets in layers, and a complete .dockerignore.

plugins.name: env-protector
plugins.description: Find leaked API keys, passwords and tokens in your code, scan staged files before commit, and keep .env secrets out of Claude's context and your git history.

plugins.name: env-setup-wizard
plugins.description: Find out what a freshly cloned repo needs to run: runtime versions, package manager, missing .env keys, Docker services and the right start commands, then set it up step by step.

plugins.name: exa-search
plugins.description: Give Claude live web search for current docs, release notes, changelogs and error messages newer than its training data, with dated sources. Uses the official Exa MCP server.

plugins.name: figma-to-code
plugins.description: Turn Figma frames into React, Vue or HTML components that reuse your design tokens and existing components, responsive and accessible. Uses Figma's official MCP server.

plugins.name: flaky-test-detector
plugins.description: Run your test suite several times, list the tests that pass and fail at random with their failure rate, then find the likely cause of each and fix it.

plugins.name: graphql-guardian
plugins.description: Catch breaking GraphQL schema changes before merge, find N+1 database queries in resolvers, and check pagination, depth and cost limits. Works with any SDL schema.

plugins.name: headroom
plugins.description: Work with huge logs, long docs, big JSON and CSV files without filling the context: outline first, read only what matters, keep a digest with line references.

plugins.name: i18n-sync
plugins.description: Find missing, extra and untranslated keys in i18n locale JSON files, check placeholders, and detect hardcoded strings. Works with react-i18next, next-intl, vue-i18n and similar.

plugins.name: legacy-refactor-pilot
plugins.description: Modernize legacy code step by step: upgrade frameworks, replace deprecated APIs and old patterns, with tests and type checks after every change.

plugins.name: mock-data-hydrator
plugins.description: Generate realistic seed and test data that matches your schema: Prisma seeds, Django fixtures, Rails seeds, SQL inserts or JSON, with foreign keys and edge cases.

plugins.name: omniout
plugins.description: Make your app's AI calls reliable: timeouts, retries with backoff, rate limit handling and fallback across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other models.

plugins.name: perf-profiler
plugins.description: Find out why a page is slow: Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights results explained, LCP, INP and CLS causes, biggest savings first, plus React and Vue re-render and memory leak checks.

plugins.name: pr-story-aligner
plugins.description: Check a pull request against its Jira, Linear or GitHub issue before merge: each acceptance criterion marked done, partial or missing, plus out-of-scope changes.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Give Claude Code long-term memory per project: remember decisions, conventions and setup across sessions in a local SQLite file. Recall, update and forget on demand.

plugins.name: prompt-tightener
plugins.description: Review and rewrite prompts and system prompts for Claude and other LLMs: find repetition, filler and vague instructions, keep template variables, and measure the token savings.

plugins.name: responsive-check
plugins.description: Screenshot any page at phone, tablet and desktop sizes and find horizontal overflow and layout bugs. Uses the Chrome or Edge you already have, nothing to install.

plugins.name: rls-schema-explorer
plugins.description: Let Claude read your real Supabase tables, columns and RLS policies before writing queries, migrations or supabase-js code. Read-only, official Supabase MCP server.

plugins.name: smart-commits
plugins.description: Generate clear git commit messages from your staged diff in Conventional Commits format, with the why in the body, matched to your repo's style.

plugins.name: task-observer
plugins.description: Turn your corrections into lasting rules in CLAUDE.md, so Claude Code remembers your package manager, style and conventions in every session.

plugins.name: test-coverage-intelligence
plugins.description: Turn lcov, Cobertura, Istanbul, JaCoCo or Go coverage reports into a list of the riskiest untested code, ranked by git churn, then write the missing tests.
